profile.headline: Software Engineer at AWS
profile.summary:
Full-stack/front-end engineer with a marketing and design background. Always seeking opportunities to leverage my multidisciplinary skills and drive impactful solutions. I enjoy creating delightful user experiences and tackling novel challenges with innovative solutions.

In my spare time, I enjoy snowboarding, yoga, and just staying active and outdoors!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Leading UI feature development on AWS EMR, Athena and SageMaker Unified Studio.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Java · Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) · Amazon Athena · AWS SageMaker

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Spearheaded and executed on an a self-service user data subject access request flow, streamlining processes for both CX and end users
- Orchestrated pivotal feature updates for Twitch’s consent management platform in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, CNIL etc., preventing fines from data protection agencies and enabling millions of dollars in ad revenue
- Build features for Twitch’s Users Service, a large scale high throughput service (1M+ RPS) for storing and managing user data
- Plan, scope, and mentor junior engineers on execution of Twitch’s Privacy Center, increasing transparency around how Twitch handles user privacy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design and architect MVPs for Google’s Area 120 teams using Python, Vue.js, Angular, etc.
- Lead UI overhaul of Google Careers Site and migration from static site using HTML templating to Vue.js
- Plan, scope and deliver rapid validation/proof of concept work with ambitious timelines, e.g. original proof of concept for Google Kids Space in Vue.js and PIXI.js
- Optimize projects through implementation of CI/CD, making improvements to performance (reduce asset sizes, implementing prefetching, recommending static site generation over SPA for specific use cases)
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Angular · Vue · Python (Programming Language) · Front-End Development · Software Development · Pixi.js · D3.js · Three.js

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
- Build user interfaces using React/Redux on top of Synapse's API to allow clients to launch products quickly
- Architect and execute on bank login, user verification, debit card dashboard, and chatbot applications, defining the standard for the UI as a Service product line
- Take on project management responsibilities to organize and set short and long-term goals as the team lead 
- Create new website for documentation along with an internal editor tool, using Github + Netlify to maintain a serverless flow for updates

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description:
- Onboard new clients by providing comprehensive API walkthrough (common flow, OAuth, user verification, JSON request/response payload examples via Postman, etc.)
- Improve core libraries (Python, Ruby, NodeJS, PHP) and REST API based on client feedback
- Build out user interfaces and dashboards to streamline onboarding/integration processes
- Write comprehensive documentation for new products and API endpoints
- Program unique controls on client environments to account for transaction limits, KYC requirements, etc.

positions.title: Assistant Paralegal
positions.description: Prepared documents and completed AOS and I-140 applications for foreign nationals to file with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services, necessary for work authorization. Handled over 100 accounts for NVIDIA, Gilead and Dolby Laboratories employees.

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description: Responsible for maintaining and tracking all online marketing, optimizing channels to be more accessible and engaging to target audience. My biggest accomplishment was developing a marketing strategy for commercial division that resulted in record-breaking sales of $143,941 in 2014’s Q1. Other responsibilities included creating signage and collateral to increase local brand recognition, and assembling mailing lists to e-blast monthly newsletter, product promotions and various drip campaigns.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description: Repositioned the brand as “luxury home sellers” by developing a brand identity that appeals to target consumers, and improved website through switching over to a more efficient CRM platform and restructuring site map. During the period that I was here, I boosted ratings to 5 stars on review sites, including Zillow, Angie's List and Yelp through soliciting past clients for their honest reviews. I also took the initiative to produce promotional materials to improve business visibility, successfully generating leads.

positions.title: After School Education and Safety Tutor
positions.description: Brought at-risk 2nd-6th grade students up to speed with curriculum through implementing an after school lesson plan to include math, literature, art and physical education. Here I acted as the liaison between child, teacher and parent, and provided consistent feedback on each child's progress.

positions.title: Member Services Attendant
positions.description: Part of my duties here included assisting patrons with inquiries either on location or over the phone/email. I also managed front desk and equipment room transactions and inventory and was able to increase membership sales through promoting the ARC. My department was in charge of regulating the special events held in this venue.

company.name: UC Davis Campus Recreation and Unions

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
My primary focus at ReMax was to grow the firm's client database through cold calling and following up on prior inquiries. To optimize realtor efficiency, I drafted lists of properties specific to client’s requirements using MLS as a search tool and prepared legal documents to be completed by clients.
I also promoted properties through use of online classified advertisements.

positions.title: Formalwear Specialist
positions.description: As a formalwear specialist, I used my knowledge of formalwear trends and customer preferences to pick out the perfect rental for each individual. We recorded customer measurements in order to provide formalwear that fits, and handled all transactions from renting to returning formalwear.

positions.title: Summer Tutor
positions.description: Khai Tri is a mathematics tutoring service for Vietnamese speaking students between 2nd grade to high school seniors. I developed a learning curriculum for a basic trigonomery class and translated the lectures into Vietnamese for a class of students with language barriers. We worked one-on-one with students who needed extra help with lessons.

honors.title: King Hall Outreach Program Scholar
honors.description:
• Selected by the King Hall School of Law to participate in intensive 2 year pre-law program
• Curriculum involved courses in legal writing and analytics as well as public speaking practice in Mock Trial/Moot Court
honors.issuer: Issued by UC Davis School of Law · Jun 2012

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Coordinated campus bone marrow drives, in charge of volunteer recruitment
• Set up quarterly registration booths for bone marrow donors

projects.title: Common Cents
projects.description: A public transparency tool that helps citizens understand where government money flows, how policy decisions shape those flows, and how they can influence those decisions through democratic participation.

organizations.name: Asian American Donor Program
organizations.position: UC Davis Volunteer Coordinator · Sep 2012 - Jun 2013
organizations.description:
•	Actively promoted and coordinated campus campaigns for bone marrow drives
•	Set up quarterly registration booths for bone marrow donors
•	Recruited more volunteers from other organizations
